parity_summary.parity_note: null when no in-scope packet exists; a parity claim over an empty population is never a pass. NOTE: equality of the two gates' block decisions is NOT an expected invariant - they measure different things (pooled counter-label support RATE vs per-bundle geometry criterion-COUNT), so a packet may be geometry-deficient while its label rate is fine. The measured divergence is reported, not closed.

geometry_incumbent_floor_disclosure.disclosure: the enforced geometry incumbent is NOT the worst case in the accepted population; it is the served packet's own score. The gate still blocks those packets, because the predicate is 'below the incumbent', but an admission consumer must not read 'PASS_NO_REGRESSION' as 'no geometry defect exists anywhere in the population'.
